cases.summary: Include the carrier tracking URL in OrderShipped events
cases.planted: schemas/json/order-shipped.schema.json is a closed content model (`additionalProperties: false`) and the change adds the optional property carrierTrackingUrl, while shipping/src/events/order-shipped.ts starts sending it. Under a closed model, adding an optional property is backward-compatible but not forward-compatible, so the subject's BACKWARD setting accepts it; consumers still validating against the current schema reject every OrderShipped event that carries the new property.

cases.whyOk: Only forecasting's reader schema widens quantityDelta to long; the producer's writer schema is untouched and still int, and Avro promotes an int writer to a long reader. The listener and DemandModel are widened in the same diff.

cases.summary: Distinguish unreported stock from zero stock on Product and add product tags
cases.planted: proto/acme/catalog/v1/product.proto adds the proto3 `optional` label to the existing field `int32 stock_level = 4`. Adding or removing proto3 optional on an existing field is incompatible (AIP-149 via AIP-180): it changes the generated source API, so in Go `Product.StockLevel` becomes `*int32` and Java gains has/clear accessors. The mapper.go hunk shows the new pointer type; every other consumer of the published github.com/acme/catalog-api Go module that sets or reads `StockLevel` as int32 stops compiling, and it ships as a minor v1.14.0 release.

cases.planted: schemas/payments/payment-status-changed.avsc adds the symbol REFUNDED to the PaymentStatus enum, which has no enum `default`, and RefundService.java starts emitting it in the same change.  from __future__ import annotations

 from confluent_kafka import Consumer
 from sqlalchemy import text

 from ledger.db import session_scope
 from ledger.events import decode_payment_status_changed


 def run(consumer: Consumer) -> None:
     consumer.subscribe(["payments.payment-status-changed"])
     while True:
         msg = consumer.poll(1.0)
         if msg is None or msg.error():
             continue
         evt = decode_payment_status_changed(msg.value())
-        if evt["status"] != "CAPTURED":

-            continue
-        with session_scope() as s:

+        elif evt["status"] == "REFUNDED":

cases.summary: Accept sandbox webhook deliveries from partners
cases.siblingDomain: security: signature check skipped on a caller-set header
cases.whyOk: Authentication bypass: the signature check is skipped whenever the caller sends X-Partner-Environment: sandbox, a header any sender controls, and the unsigned event still goes to the same payment handler as a live one. cases.summary: Add VoidInvoice RPC and issued_at, and carry invoice totals as int64
cases.planted: proto/acme/billing/v1/invoice.proto changes Invoice.total_cents (field 3) from int32 to int64. The binary wire treats the two as compatible, but InvoiceService is published over HTTP through Envoy's grpc_json_transcoder (deploy/envoy/billing.yaml, google.api.http on GetInvoice and ListInvoices), and ProtoJSON writes 64-bit integers as JSON strings. Every HTTP client of /v1/invoices/{id} and /v1/customers/{customer_id}/invoices now receives "totalCents": "1999" instead of a number, so typed or arithmetic consumers break; it also changes the generated Go and Java field types for consumers of the published package.

cases.summary: Read the carrier tracking URL from OrderShipped in analytics
cases.whyOk: The change is on the consumer side only: analytics' copy of the closed schema learns the optional property before any producer sends it (consumers first), the field is optional in the TypeScript type, and the new column has a default.

cases.summary: Emit REFUNDED payment status from refunds
cases.whyOk: The PaymentStatus enum already declares "default": "UNKNOWN" in the current schema (context line), so readers on the old schema resolve the unknown REFUNDED symbol to UNKNOWN instead of failing; refundId is a nullable union with a null default.

cases.summary: Expose the ledger FX helpers as a public subpath and use them in checkout
cases.whyOk: packages/ledger/package.json adds "./fx" to `exports` with its own entry point, checkout imports exactly `@acme/ledger/fx`, and checkout moves to `moduleResolution: node16`, under which TypeScript honours `exports`, so compile time and Node at run time agree on the public surface.

cases.summary: Rename src/infra to src/adapters and look up charge age in the refund policy
cases.planted: src/policies/refund-policy.ts now imports fetchChargeAgeDays from ../adapters/stripe/refunds, so the pure policy layer calls Stripe. .dependency-cruiser.cjs declares that src/(domain|policies) must not depend on infrastructure, but its `to.path` is still '^src/infra/', and the same diff renames src/infra to src/adapters; the rule matches nothing, CI stays green and the layering is silently lost.

cases.summary: Move payment events into the ledger proto package
cases.planted: The proto file moves PaymentCaptured and PaymentRefunded from package acme.payments.v1 to acme.ledger.v1. internal/outbox/writer.go packs every event with anypb.New, which stores the type URL type.googleapis.com/acme.payments.v1.PaymentCaptured in the outbox row and in the Kafka payload the relay forwards. After the rename, cmd/relay/dispatch.go's UnmarshalTo into ledgerv1 types fails on every row written before the deploy, and every downstream consumer unpacking the Any by the old full name breaks; the message's package name is part of the contract through the Any type URL.

cases.summary: Add carrier to ShipmentUpdated events and tidy the JSON tags
cases.planted: internal/events/shipment.go changes the IsFinal tag to `json:"isFinal,omitempty"`. encoding/json omits a false bool under omitempty, so every non-final update (label_created, in_transit, out_for_delivery) is published without isFinal, while schemas/events/shipment-updated.schema.json, which the CloudEvent names as its dataschema, lists isFinal in required. Consumers validating against that schema reject most ShipmentUpdated events.
